description:
Sa-Token based authentication & authorization (login state, native annotation auth, permission SPI)
        with auto-configuration for d4peng common modules. Introduces sa-token only via the
        official sa-token-spring-boot3-starter jar (its spring auto-configurations are excluded by a self-written
        EnvironmentPostProcessor); every auto-injection & related configuration is self-written under the
        d4peng.auth.* prefix.
